hyperedges.label: MedOrganize Cozy Gamification Currency & Rewards Loop

nodes.label: Duplicate File Detection
nodes.rationale: Finds duplicates via md5 hash, filename, and size comparisons; always asks for confirmation before deleting to avoid destructive mistakes.

nodes.label: Organization Plan Workflow
nodes.rationale: Propose a plan (current state, proposed structure, changes) before executing, so user can approve/modify rather than have files moved without consent.

nodes.label: Sidebar Menu Order Spec
nodes.rationale: Defines the exact required order of sidebar buttons: Loja Cozy & Gacha, Aparência & Bichinhos, Minijogos, Missões Diárias, Configurações, Estatísticas de Estudo.

nodes.label: Pet Care / Friendship Level Mechanic
nodes.rationale: Each pet has a friendship XP bar leveled up via feeding/playing with purchased items (Lanchinhos, Brinquedos) using MedTokens, unlocking bonuses/cosmetics to encourage engagement.

nodes.label: Termo Cozy Minigame (Wordle-like)
nodes.rationale: 5-letter word guessing game in 6 tries modeled on term.ooo, rewarding MedTokens once per day free, extra plays cost tokens, to gamify study breaks.

nodes.label: Game Loop & State Technical Spec
nodes.rationale: Keep game state (Termo match, pet XP, food stock) in localStorage, use anime.js for animations, and validate guessed words (accent-insensitive) for a smoother UX.

nodes.label: Behavioral Guidelines for LLM Coding
nodes.rationale: Guidelines bias toward caution over speed to reduce common LLM coding mistakes; for trivial tasks judgment applies. Working if diffs shrink, rewrites drop, and clarifying questions come before implementation.

nodes.label: Think Before Coding
nodes.rationale: State assumptions explicitly, surface tradeoffs, ask when unclear instead of picking an interpretation silently.

nodes.label: Simplicity First
nodes.rationale: Minimum code that solves the problem; no speculative abstractions, flexibility, or error handling for impossible scenarios.

nodes.label: Surgical Changes
nodes.rationale: Touch only what you must; every changed line should trace directly to the user's request; only clean up orphans your own changes created.

nodes.label: Goal-Driven Execution
nodes.rationale: Transform tasks into verifiable goals with success criteria and loop until verified; strong criteria enable independent iteration.

nodes.label: Plano de Aprimoramento das Ferramentas MedNotes
nodes.rationale: Fix ruler and text tools, add pen/highlighter types, and move options into popovers opened by clicking the tool. Executed in four testable phases (A: foundation, B: brushes, C: ruler, D: text) so each phase closes independently in the browser.
nodes.norm_label: plano de aprimoramento das ferramentas mednotes

nodes.label: toolSettings Per-Tool State
nodes.rationale: Replaces global penColor/penSize/penOpacity with a per-tool map so each tool remembers its own configuration; pen and highlighter previously shared state and looked identical on mouse (variable width only worked with S-Pen).

nodes.label: brushType Stroke Model
nodes.rationale: Adds brushType to serialized strokes and turns the renderer into a per-type dispatcher (ballpoint, fountain, pencil, fineliner, round, chisel, auto-straight-line). Fountain pen varies width by pressure AND velocity so it works with a mouse. Old strokes without brushType fall back to ballpoint for backward compatibility.

nodes.label: Rich Tool Popovers
nodes.rationale: Extends existing _togglePopover (previously only eraser/lasso/shapes) to pen, highlighter and eraser with type selector, size presets+slider, color swatches and opacity; removes color/thickness pickers from the right toolbar group. Touch targets must be >=44px for tablet.

nodes.label: Ruler Visibility + Snap Fix
nodes.rationale: Root cause: ruler only drew when _ruler.active, which could only be toggled by clicking the invisible ruler (deadlock). Fix: initialize at viewport center on tool activation, always draw while active, and snap strokes by projecting points onto the ruler line (same projection math as the body hit-test).

nodes.label: Persisted Editable Text Elements
nodes.rationale: Root cause: .canvas-text-element div had no CSS, no position, was blocked by canvas-ui pointer capture and never persisted. Fix: create boxes in #text-overlays layer, persist page.textElements[] {id,cx,cy,text,color,size,font}, re-render on loadActivePage, reposition on pan/zoom.

nodes.label: MedNotes Navigation Redesign Spec
nodes.rationale: The tree sidebar worked but gave a poor overview (no folder overview, no notebook previews) and looked generic ('made by AI'). Approved solution: 4 navigable screens in the central area plus a mini icon rail, with 'papelaria + cozy' identity. Migration must be additive; existing mednotes_data can never be lost.

nodes.label: MedNotes.Views Screen Router (Home/Pasta/Caderno/Editor)
nodes.rationale: Four screens, one visible at a time, controlled by Views.route {view, folderId, notebookId} and document.body.dataset.view. No URL routing because the app is local and iframe-friendly. App always opens on Home (auto-open of first page removed). Editor (screen 4) keeps canvas/toolbar untouched.

nodes.label: Papelaria + Cozy Visual Identity
nodes.rationale: Physical paper objects with warm palette + blue/purple: folders as kraft binders with color tab and pill label, notebooks as moleskine deluxe covers (stitching, purple elastic, orange ribbon, emoji seal), cream paper background #f6f3ec. Validated via approved HTML mockups before implementation.

nodes.label: Mini-Rail Icon Navigation
nodes.rationale: 58px rail replacing the tree sidebar: gradient home button, per-folder emoji shortcuts tinted with folder color, and a footer back button to MedOrganize (index.html). Provides Home access from anywhere including inside the editor.

nodes.label: Additive DataStore Migration (color/icon/label/username)
nodes.rationale: Notebook gains color (default: parent folder color) and icon (default 📓); folder gains label (null = name in caps); new localStorage key mednotes_username for the greeting. Migration runs in DataStore.load() filling missing fields with defaults, writing directly to localStorage to avoid triggering save() before init. Non-destructive: existing notes intact.

nodes.label: MedNotes Navigation Redesign Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: 9 sequential tasks; the old sidebar deliberately coexists with the new screens until Task 7 so the app stays usable between commits. Vanilla JS/CSS/localStorage, no external deps, verification via node --check + orphan-reference greps + manual browser checklists (no test framework in the project).

nodes.label: MedNotes.Actions Shared Actions Module
nodes.rationale: Extracts promptCreate/promptRename/promptDelete/duplicatePage/showToast/reorderPages from Sidebar into a neutral module so the Sidebar can be removed without breaking PageManager. Also fixes a pre-existing bug: #toast-container did not exist in the HTML so showToast was a silent no-op.

nodes.label: MedNotes.Popover Generic Floating Popover
nodes.rationale: Single fixed-position popover host for card ⋯ menus, emoji grid and color grid; anchors to the trigger element, clamps to the viewport, and closes on outside click.

nodes.label: MedNotes.EmojiPicker Curated Grid
nodes.rationale: ~40 curated emojis (medicine + study: 🏥🫀🧠💊🩺...) instead of an external emoji lib, per the no-external-dependencies constraint; writes to folder.icon / notebook.icon.

nodes.label: MedNotes.Rail Module
nodes.rationale: Renders the mini-rail into #mn-rail: home button, per-folder shortcut buttons styled with --f-color, and exit button that calls the global returnToMedOrganize(). Re-rendered by Views.refresh and Actions.refreshUI so new folders appear immediately.

nodes.label: Tree Sidebar Removal (Task 7)
nodes.rationale: Deletes the whole MedNotes.Sidebar module, sidebar markup/CSS and toggle only after Actions and the new screens cover all CRUD; safe because Sidebar methods were reduced to one-line delegations to Actions in Task 1. Mandatory orphan-reference grep must return zero MedNotes.Sidebar hits.

nodes.label: MedNotes Page Peek Scroll Spec (Espiada + Snap)
nodes.rationale: Scrolling to the end of a page reveals the next page peeking underneath with elastic resistance; crossing a threshold animates the real page switch (or creates a new page on the last one). Works in both directions and fixes, in passing, the bug where the ruled background did not follow the pan.
nodes.norm_label: mednotes page peek scroll spec (espiada + snap)

nodes.label: Espiada + Snap (Peek then Commit) Approach
nodes.rationale: Chosen over (A) a true multi-page coordinate-space rewrite (high risk, large scope) and (B) instant switch with fade (low risk but no visual preview). The peek is purely visual/transitory and never replaces the authoritative Canvas state before the snap completes, so undo/redo, minimap, autosave and the Pages panel keep working unchanged — the real switch still goes through setActiveSelection/loadActivePage. Two gesture models: drag decides on pointer-up against a 40% threshold; wheel/trackpad has no release so it commits immediately on crossing the threshold.

nodes.label: MedNotes.Canvas Single-Page Singleton Engine
nodes.rationale: Code exploration confirmed the ~2270-line module holds exactly one page: one strokes array, one view {x,y,zoom}, one CANVAS_W/H pair; switching pages replaces this state wholesale. No multi-page logic exists (no inertia, no stacking, no cross-page scroll). Also found latent bugs: page.canvasW/H read but never written, and CANVAS_W/H never reset to default when switching to a page without override.

nodes.label: Background Render Unification Fix
nodes.rationale: _renderBackground computed screen coordinates by hand while _renderStrokes used ctx.translate/scale — two techniques for the same effect. Unifying both on translate/scale fixes the 'background looks fixed during pan' bug and is a technical prerequisite for the peek: the same draw function must be able to render page X at offset Y, which is far simpler with transforms than duplicated manual math. lineWidth/shadowBlur/dotR are divided by zoom to preserve the exact previous on-screen thickness.

nodes.label: MedNotes Page Peek Scroll Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: 6 sequential tasks all inside src/notes/notes.js (MedNotes.Canvas); no new files, no HTML/CSS. Tasks 3-5 build the peek in layers (visual → decision → animation) so each is usable and testable before the next exists. _clampPan() stays untouched for zoomAt; only the two pan call sites (wheel and drag) switch to _clampPanWithPeek().
nodes.norm_label: mednotes page peek scroll implementation plan

nodes.label: Elastic Overscroll (_clampPanWithPeek / _dampPeek)
nodes.rationale: Rubber-band damping max*(1-exp(-raw/max)) approaches PEEK_MAX (220px) asymptotically, iOS-style. X axis always clamps normally — the peek is vertical only, consistent with landscape page format. The _peek state caches parsed neighbor strokes to avoid JSON.parse per frame.

nodes.label: Canvas._getNeighborPage Helper
nodes.rationale: Locates the adjacent page in the same notebook; deliberately NEVER creates a page — creation only happens when the snap is confirmed (_confirmPeek). Returns pageId:null for 'next' past the last page, and null for 'prev' on the first page (no peek there).

nodes.label: Canvas._confirmPeek Threshold Commit
nodes.rationale: Drag commits on pointer-up when amount >= PEEK_MAX * PEEK_COMMIT_RATIO (0.4); wheel commits immediately at PEEK_WHEEL_TRIGGER (140px) because wheel has no release gesture. Creates the new page via DataStore.createPage (unnamed, auto-numbered) only when confirming past the last page, then hands off to setActiveSelection.

nodes.label: Snap-Through / Bounce-Back Animation (_animatePeekTo)
nodes.rationale: requestAnimationFrame (not CSS — content is canvas) with easeOutCubic: ~300ms snap-through to the neighbor before the real switch, ~220ms bounce-back below threshold. _peek.snapping=true blocks new peek gestures during the animation. Zoom is preserved during the animation to avoid a scale jump.

nodes.label: Fixed Aesthetic Decorations Convention (popcat, cherry blossom)
nodes.rationale: Permanent decorations are read by exact filename (popcat.gif above the search bar, cherry_blossom.gif in the corners) so the user can swap decorations by replacing files with the same names, without touching code.
nodes.norm_label: fixed aesthetic decorations convention (popcat, cherry blossom)

nodes.label: Animal Asset Naming Convention (animal_1..12)
nodes.rationale: Slot-based names animal_1..animal_12 (.gif/.png/.webp) let the site auto-discover pet images; missing files are simply not shown in the discovery Tinder to avoid broken links.

nodes.label: Tinder de Descobertas (asset discovery UI)
nodes.rationale: A swipe-style discovery UI that surfaces user-provided animals and backgrounds; only slots with existing files are shown, making the asset folders the single source of truth.

nodes.label: Background Asset Naming Convention (bg_1..12)
nodes.rationale: Slot-based names bg_1..bg_12 (.jpg/.png/.webp/.gif, static or animated) for auto-discovered site backgrounds; empty slots are hidden from the Tinder to avoid broken links.

nodes.label: MedOrganize Cozy Main Page
nodes.rationale: Studio Ghibli-inspired study organizer: task checklist, gamification bar (pomodoros, study time, tasks, MedTokens, gacha coins), theme toggle, and modal panels for shop/aesthetics/instructions/quests/settings/stats.

nodes.label: Fullscreen Pomodoro Focus Flow (Preparo/Foco/Pausa)
nodes.rationale: Three-stage fullscreen session: Preparo with poppable prep-task balloons and 3-2-1 countdown, Foco with animal mascot and error-notebook button, Pausa with fog overlay, guided breathing and rotating break suggestions.

nodes.label: Cozy Shop & Gacha
nodes.rationale: Shop modal with tabs for backgrounds, animals, pet-care items and a gacha machine; gacha coins cost 30 tokens, one roll costs 1 coin, with a cinematic curtain reveal and pet naming.

nodes.label: Pet Care System
nodes.rationale: Active pet has rarity badge and evolution-point progress; care items (pãozinho +15, chá +25, novelo +40) are bought with tokens in the shop and consumed from stock in the aesthetics panel.

nodes.label: Termo Minigame (Wordle-like)
nodes.rationale: 5-letter/6-attempt daily word game with virtual keyboard; free once per day (20-token prize), extra games cost 10 tokens.

nodes.label: Fishing Minigame (Pesca Cozy)
nodes.rationale: Stardew-style fishing with lobby (weather, streak, active rod), waiting/bite/minigame screens on a canvas gauge, catalog, rods and missions sub-tabs; 3 free casts per day. Tab currently hidden (display:none).

nodes.label: Caderno de Erros (Error Notebook)
nodes.rationale: Notebook modal opened during the Foco stage to jot mistakes on ruled lines, paired with an interactive flowchart image with clickable hotspot regions explaining note-taking principles.

nodes.label: Lofi Study Music Player Panel
nodes.rationale: Persistent right panel in the focus screen with three sources: Spotify embed, YouTube embed, and a local ambiance synthesizer (rain/fireplace/chimes/waves) with volume control; user playlists configurable in settings.

nodes.label: MedNotes App Shell (notes.html)
nodes.rationale: App shell loading notes.js, notes-views.js, notes-drive.js and Google Identity Services; contains transition overlay, mini-rail, views container, drawing toolbar, triple-canvas wrapper (bg/main/ui) plus #text-overlays, and modals for search, page settings, app settings and templates.

nodes.label: MedNotes Drawing Toolbar
nodes.rationale: Tools: hand, pen, highlighter, eraser, lasso, shapes, ruler, text, laser; breadcrumb links jump to folder/notebook views; right group holds page manager, page settings, undo/redo, save status and Drive sync status.

nodes.label: Tool Popovers Markup (pen/highlighter/eraser/lasso/shapes)
nodes.rationale: Placed outside the header for correct fixed positioning. Pen popover offers ballpoint/fountain/pencil/fineliner types; highlighter offers round/chisel/line types — matching Fase A of the tools improvement plan — plus size presets, sliders, color swatches and opacity.

nodes.label: returnToMedOrganize()
nodes.rationale: Global function in the inline script that plays the exit overlay animation then navigates to ../main/index.html; the plan explicitly forbids moving or renaming it because the Rail depends on it.

nodes.label: Service Worker Registration (sw.js, Passo 17)
nodes.rationale: Registers sw.js on load to cache the app shell for offline use; an offline banner in the toolbar area announces local-only saving until the connection returns.

nodes.label: Google Drive Sync UI (notes-drive.js + GSI)
nodes.rationale: Loads notes-drive.js (OAuth + sync, Passos 15-17) and the Google Identity Services client; toolbar shows a cloud sync status button and the app settings panel has a Google Drive section.
